Editor.fallbackNote: Not translated yet. Fields show the English text as a hint.

Editor.linesHelp: The heading shows on two lines; the second line is highlighted in the brand colour.

Editor.readingTime: {count, plural, one {# min read} other {# min read}}
Editor.sharedNote: Set in English; every language uses the same.

Editor.altMissing: No description in this language yet.
Editor.priceNote: {price} a month on the website, from its purchasing catalog (shown in Pricing).
Editor.marksHelp: Keep the marks ({m}, {em}) where they are: they style part of the text.

Editor.placeholdersHelp: Keep {p} and the other numbered parts: the website puts a name or a number there.

Editor.errorEffectiveFrom: A published version needs the date it applies from.
Editor.versionHelp: The number this draft gets when it’s published, e.g. 1.0.

Editor.priceModeHelp: This is the historical reference display mode. It does not change current checkout pricing.
Editor.pricesLocked: You can change the words here. Numbers, switches and the price mode need pricing permission.
Editor.pricesNote: A change to a number goes to an Admin for approval before the website shows it.
Editor.firstVersion: The first version: imported from the website.
Editor.moreChanges: {count, plural, one {and # more change} other {and # more changes}}
Editor.restoreImpact: It becomes a new draft on top of the history, which stays as it is. The website doesn’t change until the draft is published.

translationDone.approve: Translation approved: it goes live with the next publish

Editor.fourEyesTranslation: You translated this, so someone else has to review it.
Editor.scheduleBody: The website shows this version from the date and time you choose.
Editor.errorFuture: Choose a time in the future.
Editor.unscheduled: Back to approved: it won’t publish by itself
Editor.scheduledFor: The website shows this version from {when}.
Editor.errorSlugTaken: Another entry here already uses this address. Choose a different one.

Editor.newBody: Start blank or explicitly copy an entry. New content stays private until reviewed and published.
Editor.name: Name
Editor.startFromHelp: Copy text and images from an entry, or start with empty fields. Copied cases retain their department and start with sample figures and narrative disabled.
Editor.created: Created. Fill it in, then submit it for review.
Editor.fixedSet: The site's design has a place for each of these, so they can't be added or removed here; that's a design change.
Editor.takeOffImpact: {address} will redirect to {listing}. It stays here with its history and can go back on the site.
Editor.takeOffImpactNoAddress: It leaves the site. It stays here with its history and can go back on the site.
Editor.deleteImpact: It has never been on the site. Its drafts and history go too, and this can't be undone.
Editor.needsApprove: Only an approver can do this.
Editor.managedIn: Kept in the website's code ({file}), which the cart and checkout read too. Shown here read-only.
Editor.departmentHelp: Choose a department to determine this case study’s format.
Editor.narrativePermission: Only a content approver may enable or disable the narrative.
Editor.narrativeSamples: Confirm the figures as approved results before enabling the narrative.
Editor.narrativeHelp: The narrative appears on the website after review and publication.
Editor.narrativeDisabled: Narrative disabled. The project card can appear without its story or results.
Editor.fixedValuesHelp: Fixed values supplied by the website’s code; keep every numbered placeholder.
Editor.sampleNarrativeHelp: Shows the story and results with visible sample labels after review and publication. Figures remain unapproved.

Ideas.title: Ideas
Ideas.description: Suggestions from the public roadmap form. Pending ideas remain private; public voting is a page-local preview.

impact.publish: It appears on the roadmap with example counts and page-local voting. Comments are sample counts.
impact.plan: The roadmap shows it as planned. Voting remains a local preview.
impact.start: The roadmap page shows it as in progress.
impact.ship: The roadmap page shows it as shipped, with a link to what came out of it.
impact.decline: It leaves the roadmap page. The reason is kept in its history.
impact.hide: It never appears on the website: for spam or anything that shouldn’t be public. The reason is kept.

Ideas.mergeImpact: {votes, plural, =0 {It has no votes yet; it closes as merged.} one {Its # vote moves to the idea you pick, and it closes as merged.} other {Its # votes move to the idea you pick, and it closes as merged.}}
Ideas.stale: Someone else changed this idea. The list now shows the latest.
Ideas.errorLink: Use a link that starts with / or https://.
Ideas.counts: {votes, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} · {comments, plural, one {# comment} other {# comments}}

log.merged_from: Another idea merged into this one

Ideas.masked: Personal details are masked for your role.

Ideas.noMergeTargets: No published topics match. Publish an idea first, or change your search.

Ideas.notesPrivate: Only the WM team can see these notes. They never appear on the website.

Seo.healthDescription: What each page needs to look right in a search result and when it’s shared: a checklist per page, not a score.
Seo.redirectsDescription: Old addresses and where they lead now, so links and search results keep working.
Seo.redirectHelp: Point an old address at the page that replaced it. End both with /* to carry the rest of the address over.
Seo.toHelp: A page on the site (/…) or a full https:// address.

redirectErrors.path_format: Start with / and use no spaces, ? or #.
redirectErrors.wildcard_end: The * can only come at the end, after a /.
redirectErrors.wildcard_unmatched: Use * here only if the old address ends with /* too.
redirectErrors.duplicate: This old address already has a redirect.
redirectErrors.shadows_page: A page lives at this address; a redirect would hide it.
redirectErrors.chain: That address redirects again. Point straight at where it ends up.
redirectErrors.loop: That would send visitors in a circle.

Seo.stale: Someone else changed this. The list now shows the latest.
Seo.handledByBrowser: Rewritten in the browser today; a real 301 once addresses move to the host.
Seo.deleteImpact: Old links and search results that use this address will show “Page not found”.
Seo.indexingDescription: Whether search engines may show the website, and what they’re given: the sitemap and robots.txt.

Seo.visibleBody: Search engines may list every page in the sitemap.
Seo.makeVisibleTitle: Let search engines list the website?

Seo.makeVisibleAck: The content has been approved for the public.
Seo.hideImpact: {count, plural, one {# page drops out of search results over the next days.} other {# pages drop out of search results over the next days.}}
Seo.nowVisible: The website can now appear in search
Seo.nowHidden: The website is hidden from search
Seo.visibilityPermission: Changing this needs permission to control search visibility.
Seo.sitemapNote: The addresses pages get once they move off # links; the published ones only.

block.noDescription: No description yet: search engines will pick some text from the page.
block.title: Title
block.focusHelp: The phrase this page should be found for. The checks use it; it isn't shown on the page.
block.keywordListHelp: Up to 20, for planning and reports. Press Enter to add one. They aren't written into the page (search engines ignore that tag).
block.keywordsInvalid: Keep it to 20 keywords of up to 60 characters.
block.ogFallback: Leave empty to use the search title and description.
block.ogImageHelp: Shown when the page is shared. Without one, the page's own image or the site's default is used.
block.ogImageDefault: The page's image (or the site default)
block.siteHidden: The whole site is hidden from search right now (SEO › Indexing). This page's setting applies once the site is shown.
block.canonicalHelp: Leave empty: the page's own address ({address}) is used. Set it only when another address holds the same content.
block.canonicalSeoOnly: Set by the SEO team; empty means the page's own address.
block.structuredGenerated: The site writes {type} for this page from its content. Nothing to fill in.
block.structuredNone: The site writes no structured data for this kind of page.
block.customJsonLdHelp: Optional. Added after what the site writes; it must be a JSON object with an @type, or a list of them.
block.customJsonLdLocked: Needs the custom structured data permission.

check.descriptionSet: Has a description of 50 characters or more

Site.needsLocales: Changing languages needs permission to enable languages.

errorLocales.public_needs_enabled: A public language has to be enabled.
errorLocales.invalid: Choose a supported language and valid visibility settings.
errorLocales.translation_not_ready: This new language is available for translation drafts. Public access requires website language support.

Site.errorEmail: Use an email address like name@example.ch.
Site.stale: Someone else changed the settings. Reload to see them.

Preview.title: Preview
Preview.description: The real site with your drafts, at three widths. Nothing here is published, and visitors don't see it.
Preview.tokenFailedBody: The Website Manager didn't hand out a preview. Try again in a moment.

Studio.intro: OrgTik’s internal CMS feature walkthrough. Existing publishing remains in the CMS editor.
Studio.analyticsNote: Analytics and notification entries are sample data; no external analytics provider is connected.
Studio.samplesOnly: Choose packaged samples. Arbitrary file uploads are deferred.
Studio.variantNote: Variants reuse this SVG sample at selected widths. External image conversion is deferred.
Studio.translationNote: Fixed examples simulate translation drafting; reviewed text is not published by this scene.
Studio.spamNote: These preset outcomes illustrate form spam states; they add no live anti-spam or security service.
Studio.bundleNote: Plan a group of CMS items and demonstrate review/publish/rollback. The bundle changes only this scene.
Studio.internalBody: Website Manager is OrgTik’s internal CMS. Choose OrgTik and a content/staff persona in Demo controls.
Studio.leadConnected: Lead created in OrgTik Sales with Partners attribution.
Studio.connectionError: The connection failed. Try the action again.
Studio.campaignHint: Campaigns come from OrgTik’s Marketing scene. Accepted Partners form leads carry this campaign into OrgTik CRM and Marketing; customer workspace data stays separate.
Studio.visitorNameError: Enter a contact name of 1–120 characters.

Improvements.protectedDelete: Fixed or published content cannot be deleted. Archive eligible published records from their editor.
Improvements.deleteImpact: This removes the unpublished record and its draft history.
Improvements.formattingProtected: Formatting and dynamic values are preserved automatically.
Improvements.sharedCopyHint: These texts are shared with commerce and account screens. Saved edits follow the existing review and publishing workflow.
Improvements.enableLanguageHelp: Enable a supported language for editing. Public availability is controlled in Site Settings.
Improvements.allLanguagesEnabled: All five supported languages are already enabled.
Improvements.identityHelp: Controls the website name used in shared branding and metadata.
Improvements.searchSocialHelp: Fallback title, description, and image for pages without their own SEO values.
Improvements.formsHelp: Controls whether public contact forms deliver enquiries to the Leads inbox or remain in preview mode.
Improvements.indexingHelp: This shows the policy sent to search engines. Actual Google indexing must be checked in Search Console.

Improvements.canonicalHelp: The canonical URL identifies the preferred address when content is duplicated.

Improvements.name: Name

Improvements.centralAccountsHelp: Your role can manage website access. Central administrators manage suite account details and activation.
Improvements.userManagementHelp: Manage central suite accounts and Website Manager access. Account changes apply across the suite.
Improvements.accountStale: This account changed. Close and reopen it before saving.
Improvements.accountInvalid: Check the names, unique email address, and password length.
Improvements.selfLockout: You cannot remove your own administration access.

Improvements.queueHelp: Pending work across all managed content types.
Improvements.noMediaResults: No matching media. Try another search or upload a file.
Improvements.noMediaAttached: No media attached to this section.

Improvements.mediaLanguageHelp: Media is shared across languages. Select English to change it.
Improvements.viewModeHelp: You are viewing this record. Select Edit to change its content and media.

Improvements.reviewPreviewHelp: Shows this language and your unsaved edits.

Improvements.orderFailed: Could not save the order. Try again.
Improvements.orderConflict: The list changed. Reload before arranging again.
Improvements.languageFlow: Choose a language, then prepare translations for review. New languages start as private drafts.

Improvements.rotationSourceHelp: These scrolling words use the titles of the entries below. Open an entry to manage its title.
